name: Exp_XMA_Ichimoku_Channel
summary: This EA trades breakouts of the XMA Ichimoku Channel, buying when price closes above the upper channel border and selling when price closes below the lower channel border. It uses customizable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) to construct the channel from averaged high/low prices with percentage-based band offsets. Exit signals are generated when price re-enters the channel after a breakout.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XMA一目均衡通道的突破进行交易，价格收盘突破上轨时买入，跌破下轨时卖出。通道由可配置的平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）对高低价进行平滑后加百分比偏移构建，价格重新回到通道内部时触发平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于XMA平滑一目均衡通道的突破交易，通道由对高低价时间序列进行平滑处理后加上下百分比偏移构建而成。入场条件为：当收盘价突破上轨时产生买入信号（需前一根K线未突破上轨以确认突破），当收盘价跌破下轨时产生卖出信号（同理需前一根K线未跌破下轨确认）。出场条件为：持有多头时价格回到通道内部触发平多信号，持有空头时价格回到通道内部触发平空信号，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，策略依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数执行实际交易，包含最大滑点控制。策略在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时进行信号判断，避免逐tick重复计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is breakout trading based on the XMA Ichimoku Channel, which is constructed by smoothing high/low price time series with configurable algorithms and adding percentage-based upper and lower band offsets. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the close price breaks above the upper channel border (confirmed by the previous bar's close being at or below the upper border), and a sell signal is generated when the close price breaks below the lower channel border (with similar confirmation logic). Exit conditions: when holding a long position and price re-enters the channel, a close-long signal is triggered; similarly for short positions when price rises back into the channel, plus fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for actual trade execution, including maximum slippage control via the Deviation parameter. The strategy evaluates signals only on new bar formation or when SignalBar is 0, preventing redundant per-tick calculations.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金比例/手数，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size or margin ratio

parameters.name: Up_mode
parameters.description: 高价搜索时间序列类型
parameters.description_en: Time series type for high price search

parameters.name: Dn_mode
parameters.description: 低价搜索时间序列类型
parameters.description_en: Low price search time series type

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA范围-100~+100，VIDYA为CMO周期，AMA为慢均线周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (JJMA: -100~+100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: slow MA period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 通道突破策略逻辑清晰，入场条件有确认机制（需前一根K线未突破），减少假突破
支持多种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/T3/VIDYA/AMA等），灵活性强
新K线判断机制避免逐tick重复计算，减少资源消耗和重复交易
买卖方向可独立开关控制，灵活性高
有独立的止损止盈设置和滑点控制
pros_en: Channel breakout logic is clear with a confirmation mechanism (previous bar must not have already broken out), reducing false breakouts
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/T3/VIDYA/AMA), offering high flexibility
New bar detection prevents per-tick redundant calculations, reducing resource usage and duplicate trades
Buy and sell directions can be independently enabled/disabled, providing flexibility
Has separate stop loss, take profit settings and slippage control
cons: 通道参数较多（平滑方法、深度、相位、百分比偏移等），优化空间大但容易过拟合
突破策略在震荡行情中容易频繁止损，缺少市场状态过滤机制
没有扩撒过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能产生滑点损失
信号确认逻辑较弱，仅依赖前一根K线的收盘价位置判断突破是否成立
缺少追踪止损功能，固定止盈止损可能无法适应市场波动性变化
cons_en: Many channel parameters (smoothing method, depth, phase, percentage offset) create large optimization space prone to overfitting
Breakout strategy suffers frequent stop losses in ranging markets, lacking a market state filter
No spread filter, which may cause slippage losses in low-liquidity markets
Signal confirmation logic is weak, relying only on the previous bar's close price position to validate breakouts
No trailing stop feature; fixed stop loss/take profit cannot adapt to changing market volatility
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
增加追踪止损机制，根据ATR动态调整止损，在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
增加扩撒过滤，当买卖差价过大时暂停开仓
增加成交量或波动率确认，提高突破信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add a market state filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce trade frequency or pause trading in ranging markets
Add a trailing stop mechanism that dynamically adjusts stop loss based on ATR to lock in more profits during trending markets
Add a spread filter to pause new positions when the bid-ask spread is too wide
Add volume or volatility confirmation to improve breakout signal reliability

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损信号
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，可能在极端行情下止损不足或止盈过早
缺少仓位检查逻辑，可能在已有持仓时重复开仓
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy tends to generate consecutive losing signals in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for market volatility changes, potentially resulting in insufficient stops or premature take profits during extreme conditions
Lacks position check logic, may repeatedly open positions when existing positions are already held
